chunks: He had no authority over them save for the purpose of Our knowing who believed in the world to come, and who doubted it. For your Lord keeps a watch over everything.

key_terms.الْآخِرَةِ: the Hereafter or the world to come

ai.seo_question: What is the purpose of God's authority over humans according to this verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Saba clarifies that divine dominion (sulṭān) is not for coercion but serves as a diagnostic tool to distinguish true believers from those in doubt, particularly in the context of the Day of Resurrection. It underscores God’s omniscience and protective oversight, reinforcing the concept that trials are purposeful manifestations of divine knowledge rather than arbitrary power.
